mark: Each mark is a small lacquer plate with a wash of its own colour inside a double gold inlay and cut corners, the letters in champagne Josefin capitals; round marks are jewels in a double ring, corner glyphs are gold lozenges, and the picked mark has a double gold ring.
stackbar: The bar is the inlay doubled: two gold hairlines round a dark track, the parts flat between them set apart by the lacquer, the limit a gold lozenge on a hairline, the legend swatches lozenges. The legend row you point at is warmed by gold leaf.
bullets: Pointing at a row warms it with gold leaf and a full gold hairline under it, the label turning champagne. A warning or failing figure is ruby over a gold rule (double for a failure), never a plate.
tick: While a number counts it is gilded: gold with a soft glow that settles into its ink when it lands. No swelling, no jumping.
uptime: The strip is slats of lacquer between gold hairlines: up is emerald, degraded gold with its fine rules, down ruby with its stripes, no data an empty gold frame. Pointing at a slab warms it and lights its edge to full gold; titles are Poiret capitals.
uptime-states: Loading is the glint running between two gold hairlines along the strip, with the lift doors in the busy card in the middle. Empty and failed keep the exact footprint; a failure is the words in ruby over a gold rule.
uptime-phone: The same strip at phone width, one line per strip; no text touches.
inbox: Rows are ruled by gold hairlines and say their state in a double gold edge (gold for new, emerald for in flight, ruby for warning and failure with the title in ruby over a gold rule); the next one up is warmed by gold leaf. Group headings are Poiret capitals with a double rule.
backlog: The same rows for a backlog: gold hairlines, a double edge for the state, the deco buttons with their gold inlay.
files: File rows with the format as lead, gold hairlines between rows, a failed file's title in ruby over a gold rule. Buttons keep their columns.
appointments: The day is in spaced capitals and the hour beside it; the next appointment is warmed by gold leaf with a gold edge, past ones go quieter by ink.
checks: A check with a reservation has its name in ruby over a gold rule and a square mark with a ruby exclamation in a gold hairline; failed rows do the same; the written fix is plain text.
sort: Nothing new is drawn: the table keeps deco's gold-ruled head and sort marks; a column that cannot be sorted now has no pointer and a quieter mark.
kv: Keys are spaced small capitals, rows are separated by thin gold hairlines, a changed value is marked by a gold lozenge after its key, a row that could not be read has its words in ruby over a gold rule.
formrows: Labels are spaced capitals. A row changed and not saved has a gold lozenge standing in the gap before it; a row in error has a ruby lozenge. Rows are separated by gold hairlines.
tiles: Choice tiles are plates of the lobby: lacquer with the wallpaper, coved corners and the double inlay. Pointing makes a tile glow gold inside and its edge go to full gold; the picked tile stays glowing; a disabled tile is dashed.
card-states: The card is a plate in all four states; titles are Poiret capitals; the data that returns comes up with the lacquer; loading is the lift doors in the busy card.
header: The page header's title is Poiret capitals with a wide tracking; the freshness line is Josefin; the mark and badge stay on one row without touching.
art: The drawings are the lobby's fan in gold hairlines: none is the fan closed on its pivot over the double rule, nomatch the ribs without the leaf, error one rib broken in ruby, offline two chevrons turned toward each other, done the fan wide open with its leaf, locked the fan folded shut with a lozenge clasp. They are drawn from the centre outward, two strokes at a time.
pipeline: Lanes are plates of the lobby (lacquer, coves, double inlay); heads are the stage's colour as a wash between gold hairlines with Josefin capitals and a gold count; cards are inlaid dark panels that gold leaf warms on pointing, the open card has a double gold ring.
pipeline-states: Loading shows the lift doors in the busy card; an empty or failed board has its sentence on a plate (a failure in ruby over a gold rule) and the lanes keep their places.
journey: The journey is a path of gold double rules between marks: reached steps are filled with the step's colour (emerald by default), the step it stands at has a double ring around a gold centre, to come is a faint hairline. Names are spaced capitals.
journey-states: A closed journey ends in a ruby mark and its rule turns to ruby dashes. Loading and empty keep the footprint.
contact: Moments are jewels set in gold hairlines (squares turned to lozenges); a stretch is a pair of gold hairlines, in ruby when it is a wait. Pointing at a jewel gives it a double gold ring.
contact-states: Empty and failed keep the room of the loaded line with the sentence on a plate; loading shows the lift doors in the busy card.
secret: The value sits in a dark well in a double gold hairline. When it is shown it opens from its middle to both sides, and its time running out is a gold hairline with a lozenge at its head. A failure is ruby over a gold rule.
secret-phone: The same field at phone width: buttons under the value, the line under keeps its room, nothing touches.
manage: The dialog in sections: sections are divided by a gold hairline with a lozenge at its centre, headings are spaced capitals, the danger section's heading is ruby over a gold rule, the dependants list is an inlaid dark panel.
confirm: The confirmation lists what still uses the thing in an inlaid dark panel; a blocked removal shows no field and says why.
type-dialog: The list of what will be lost is a lacquer plate with its ruby title over a gold rule; the name to type is a champagne chip in a gold hairline; the match line is always there.
type-own: The same typed block in a page's own dialog: identical parts in deco's own plate.
type-phone: The typed confirmation at phone width: everything stacks and nothing touches.
disc: The visual timer is a lacquer disc in a double gold ring: a gold sector, gold hairline tick marks and a gold lozenge hub; the name is Poiret capitals.
disc-states: Paused dims the sector. When the time is out the ring turns full gold and flares once with a soft glow.
disc-phone: Three discs at phone width: the face shrinks to fit, the name and line stay on one line each.
countdown: The countdown is a lacquer plate with the double inlay; digits are champagne Josefin with gold colons; the name is Poiret capitals.
countdown-states: Paused mutes the digits. When time is up the plate gets a double gold ring and one gold flare, then rests.
range: The preset chips are deco's segmented control; Custom wears the double gold ring while open, the panel is the usual lacquer popover, the title is Poiret capitals.
range-states: A wrong custom range turns the field's edge ruby and names the fault in a line that keeps its room.
wheel: The wheel is a dark lacquer disc in a double gold rim: segments are washes of the theme's colours between gold hairlines, the chosen one brighter with a gold edge, a gold pointer and a gold hub. It settles the way a hand opens a fan; the outcome is Poiret capitals over a double gold rule.
cook: Cook mode: each step comes up with the lacquer as it appears, the text is plain Josefin at a large size, the ingredient list is ruled with a double gold rule, the wake light is a small gold lozenge.
timers: Timer cards are lacquer plates with the double inlay, champagne digits and Poiret names. A timer that has run out gets a double gold ring and a gold flare, which repeats slowly while it rings.
quantity: The number field is a dark well in a double gold hairline; focused it gets the 3 px double gold ring; the number is champagne Josefin; the minus and plus are deco's own buttons.
checklist: Rows are ruled by gold hairlines; the row under the pointer is warmed by gold leaf; a ticked item is struck through with a gold line; a done group shows an emerald lozenge in its count; empty and failed keep the list's size. Loading is a choice: the gold-and-lacquer doors close over the whole list and open on it (recommended), or just deco's sunburst spinner in the busy card, centred.
tri: Included is an emerald jewel with a champagne tick in a gold ring, left out is a ruby jewel with a cross and the word struck through in ruby, either way a hollow ring in gold.
code: The code block is a lacquer plate with coves and the double inlay; the head is closed by a double gold rule; JSON keys are champagne; a failed read is ruby over a gold rule.
command: A terminal plate: Poiret-spaced shell name, a double gold rule under the head, a dark code area with champagne text and a gold prompt.
command-long: Long commands wrap or scroll inside the plate; continuation lines keep the prompt's width.
command-phone: The command at phone width: the head wraps, the code scrolls inside its plate, nothing touches the edge.
compare: The divider is a gold double line and the handle a lozenge jewel in a double gold hairline with the two chevrons inside; labels are small lacquer plates in spaced capitals; a failed pane has its words in ruby over a gold rule and a normal-size Retry.
compare-live: The live compare slider: dragging moves the gold line and the lozenge; panes keep their size while loading with the busy card (the lift doors) over them.
